title: CFTC staff let exchanges count Bitcoin toward operating reserves
description: A CFTC staff advisory issued Nov. 23 says regulated trading venues and clearinghouses may count bitcoin, ether and payment stablecoins toward financial resources covering at least one year of operating costs, subject to haircuts.

title: Upbit and Bithumb halt CYBER deposits after suspected bridge minting
description: South Korean exchanges Upbit and Bithumb suspended CYBER deposits and withdrawals on Nov. 22 after the Cyber project reported unexpected token minting on Solana and tokens leaving its Ethereum bridge lockbox.

title: Solo miner wins $191,000 Bitcoin block with 11 TH/s
description: A solo miner running about 11 terahashes per second solved block 977057 through Solo CKPool on Nov. 22, collecting 3.1287 BTC worth roughly $191,000.

title: Coinbase targets first half of 2027 for its own prediction market contracts
description: Coinbase plans to offer its own event contracts to U.S. retail and institutional customers in the first half of 2027, Bloomberg reported, as the exchange builds clearing and trading infrastructure around the business.

title: Wrapped Monero token XMR1 collapses 99.8% after $13.5 million sell-off
description: XMR1, Wagyu's wrapped Monero token on Hyperliquid, fell from about $500 to near zero on Nov. 20 as a deployer-linked wallet sold $13.5 million of the asset; the operator blamed a breach at its web host.
